name: SwCanvas
brief: A class for the rendering graphical elements with a software raster engine.

members.name: target
members.signature: Result target(uint32_t* buffer, uint32_t stride, uint32_t w, uint32_t h, ColorSpace cs) noexcept
members.brief: Sets the drawing target for the rasterization.
description: The buffer of a desirable size should be allocated and owned by the caller.

params.name: buffer
params.description: A pointer to a memory block of the size `stride` x `h`, where the raster data are stored.

params.name: stride
params.description: The stride of the raster image - greater than or equal to `w`.

params.name: w
params.description: The width of the raster image.

params.name: h
params.description: The height of the raster image.

params.name: cs
params.description: The value specifying the way the 32-bits colors should be read/written.

retvals.description: In case no valid pointer is provided or the width, or the height or the stride is zero.
if the canvas is performing rendering. Please ensure the canvas is synced.
In case the software engine is not supported.

notes: Currently, only `ColorSpace::ABGR8888S`, `ColorSpace::ABGR8888`, `ColorSpace::ARGB8888S`, and `ColorSpace::ARGB8888` are supported for `cs`.
warnings: Do not access `buffer` during Canvas::add() - Canvas::sync(). It should not be accessed while the engine is writing on it.

members.name: gen
members.signature: static SwCanvas* gen(EngineOption op = EngineOption::Default) noexcept
members.brief: Creates a new SwCanvas object with optional rendering engine settings.
description: This method generates a software canvas instance that can be used for drawing vector graphics. It accepts an optional parameter `op` to choose between different rendering engine behaviors.

params.name: op
params.description: The rendering engine option. Default is `EngineOption::Default`.
